module purpose: neorv32_cpu_alu compares two register operands (cmp_o), adds or subtracts selected operands (add_o), and drives a result chosen by the operation code on res_o (zero, adder, less-than, operand, bitwise logic or co-processor result). It also merges the results and valid flags of its co-processor sub-units (done_o), keeps a CFU busy state, and routes CSR write enables and CSR read data for the FPU and CFU CSR blocks (csr_o).

use-case flows.value: equal and less-than flags of rs1_i and rs2_i, signed or unsigned per ctrl_i.alu_unsigned, driven on cmp_o and to the bitmanip and FPU sub-units
operand selection and the sum or difference of the selected operands, driven on add_o
ALU result selected by ctrl_i.alu_op and driven on res_o
CFU operation request ctrl_i.alu_cp_cfu passed to the CFU start input and setting cfu_busy; active decision passed to the CFU
co-processor results driven into cp_result by the sub-units, CFU result captured under its qualification, merged into cp_res
co-processor completion: valid flags from the sub-units and the qualified CFU valid, OR-ed onto done_o
CSR write enable, address and write data passed to the FPU or CFU CSR block when the CSR address matches
FPU or CFU CSR read data, gated by the address match and returned on csr_o
cfu_busy and cp_result(4) cleared while rstn_i is '0'; cfu_busy also cleared on cfu_done or ctrl_i.cpu_trap

The flags leave through `cmp_o <= cmp;` (line 102) and go to the cmp_i inputs of the bitmanip and FPU sub-units (lines 230, 263; these exist only when the generics at lines 214 and 250 hold). The flow graph lists cmp and cmp_o as not reached from an input because a comparison is a control edge, not a data edge; the RTL lines above show the dependence. No line restricts who observes the flags, so confidentiality is not established.

conceptual assets.concept: CFU operation-in-progress state -- whether a custom-function-unit operation has started and has not yet completed or been aborted
conceptual assets.reasoning: Under RISCV_ISA_Zxcfu, cfu_busy is set when ctrl_i.alu_cp_cfu is '1' (lines 331-332). It is cleared when `(cfu_done = '1') or (ctrl_i.cpu_trap = '1')` (lines 329-330) and on reset (line 326). Without that generic it is tied to '0' (line 351). It also forms `cfu_active <= ctrl_i.alu_cp_cfu or cfu_busy;` (line 342), delivered to the CFU active_i input (line 299). Availability is also Established under the implemented conditions: the state holds from the start until completion or trap, so a completion arriving after the start cycle is still accepted (lines 332, 334). cfu_busy stores (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 4, line 332). cfu_active computes the active decision delivered to the sub-unit (GATED_BY cfu_busy, occurrence 3, line 342). ctrl_i sets the state through alu_cp_cfu (GATES cfu_busy, occurrence 30, line 331) and through cpu_trap (line 329).
